decisions.label: documented-and-verifiable
decisions.evidence_note: Input is a parent IN_PATH containing subfolders with log .txt files. Output is a CSV with columns (folder, file, vote_round, good_vote_rate, total_votes, votewolf_difficulty, avg_rate, vote1_rate). The schema is explicit in code and docstrings.

decisions.label: documented-and-verifiable
decisions.evidence_note: Docstrings and implementation define good_vote_rate as correct_votes/num_non_werewolves, avg_rate as mean good_vote_rate over votes per game, vote1_rate as first-round mean, and presentation as percentage strings.

decisions.label: documented-and-verifiable
decisions.evidence_note: Full Python implementation of the Vote evaluator, including log extraction, parsing, metric computation, aggregation, and CSV writing, is present and runnable in eval.py and utils.py.

decisions.label: documented-and-verifiable
decisions.evidence_note: Grading rules are deterministic: per-vote good_vote_rate, per-game mean over votes, and vote1_rate as groupby-mean on vote_1. No special tie-breaking is needed or used; aggregation behavior is fully explicit in code.

decisions.label: documented-and-verifiable
decisions.evidence_note: Individual vote lines in logs are parsed into werewolf/non-werewolf labels and votes, converted to per-vote good_vote_rate, then averaged per file and per first round. Mapping from raw predictions (votes) to aggregated scores is clearly coded.

decisions.label: documented-and-verifiable
decisions.evidence_note: A concrete example of a vote log chunk with players, roles, and votes is given in the _vote_rate_players docstring, illustrating expected input format. Moderator/vote patterns in utils further exemplify typical log lines.
